population.span: In a randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial of 2589 patients with acute VTE treated with low-molecular-weight or unfractionated heparin for 5 to 11 days, we compared dabigatran 150 mg twice daily with warfarin.

endpoint.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 [PRIMARY]: Number of Participants With Recurrent Symptomatic Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) and Deaths Related to VTE

estimate.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 ANALYSIS 0: groups Dabigatran 150 mg, Warfarin | Hazard Ratio (HR) 1.13 (95% CI 0.69 to 1.85) | p 0.0002 | METHOD Regression, Cox | Patients without events are censored at the end of ptp.

ci.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 ANALYSIS 0: groups Dabigatran 150 mg, Warfarin | Hazard Ratio (HR) 1.13 (95% CI 0.69 to 1.85) | p 0.0002 | METHOD Regression, Cox | Patients without events are censored at the end of ptp.

analysis_set.span: Full analysis set (FAS): consisted of all randomised patients who were documented to have taken at least one dose of study drug. Patients were assigned to the treatment groups as randomised, i.e. regardless of the actual medication taken.

treatment_strategy.span: In a randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial of 2589 patients with acute VTE treated with low-molecular-weight or unfractionated heparin for 5 to 11 days, we compared dabigatran 150 mg twice daily with warfarin.

follow_up.span: For statistical analysis 1: from randomisation to end of post treatment period (ptp), planned to be up to day 224. For statistical analysis 2: from randomisation to 6 months (up to day 180)

served_mismatch: The served HR 1.08 (95% CI 0.64–1.80) is the six-month/day-180 estimate for the correct composite endpoint. For the requested trial-end/longest follow-up, the registry reports HR 1.13 (95% CI 0.69–1.85) through the end of the post-treatment period, planned up to day 224. The documented analysis set also requires at least one dose, so the served unqualified intention-to-treat label does not describe all randomized patients.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 ANALYSIS 2: groups Dabigatran 150 mg, Warfarin | Hazard Ratio (HR) 1.08 (95% CI 0.64 to 1.8) | p None | METHOD Regression, Cox | Patients without events are censored at the earliest of last contact date or day 180.
candidate_rejections.why: Correct endpoint, but the day-180 estimate does not represent the longest reported follow-up.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Entry criteria specify adults with acute symptomatic proximal DVT and/or PE, matching the clinical question; the analysis-set restriction is reported separately.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Inclusion criteria: * Acute symptomatic uni- or bilateral Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) of the leg involving proximal veins, and/or Pulmonary Embolism (PE) * Male or female, being 18 years of age or older

notes: Registry spans were used for the longest-follow-up estimate, its CI, endpoint, analysis set, and timing. The abstract reports the six-month treatment estimate. The longest-follow-up selection includes the registry's post-treatment period; day 224 is a planned limit, not an observed follow-up duration.
